FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 6
Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Rodger M. Smitherman
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/17/2023
Senate Bill 6 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of Alabama's U.S.
Congressional districts. This bill will not affect state or local funding.
